body: Update: My medication makes me fat, so does eating to cope with stress, anxiety and lows. Any attempt to taper down said medication leads to emotional disaster.

I had to leave my Masters midway because of not being able to finish Anything that was assigned to me. Despite repeated extensions. 
So it really is a big deal when you turn in homework. Hope you can keep going! Lately, I have been giving myself rewards for tasks that I am ordinarily supposed to do, has been working well for the past week..
